name: Dire Wolf

Traits.name: Frost-Rimed Bite
Traits.text: While the dire wolf is moving toward a creature it has damaged within the last 24 hours, the dire wolf's Speed can't be reduced and Difficult Terrain doesn't cost it extra movement.
Traits.expresses: frost-rimed hide that chills what it touches

Traits.name: Pack Tactics
Traits.text: The dire wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dire wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The dire wolf makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Frost-Rimed Hide.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +5, reach 5 ft. 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.

Actions.name: Frost-Rimed Hide
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target has the Blinded condition until the end of the dire wolf's next turn.

lore: Whelped in the long winter, this dire wolf's hide never thaws, and it haunts the snowline with its pack to take whatever the cold has already weakened.

generation.userConcept: Dire Wolf — with a frost-rimed hide

clauses.text: Dire Wolf — with a frost-rimed hide
